name: OG 👑 PIVOT 15M (lane ogp15, book ogp15)
why: Love, Oct 11 ~5:30 PM PT: 'isolate the configuration from this morning and see what HER best hours are... we'll get the data on that this week'. This is the exact config she has run since ~4:50 AM PT Oct 11; any later change to pivotbooks.ts shows up as a different codeHash.
lines: Session VWAP bands (PEPPERSTONE BTCUSD / TVC GOLD, session from 5 PM ET: VWAP, ±0.5…±3σ) + 15-minute CM Pivot Bands (PP = EMA7 of hlc3; R1/S1 = PP ± avg7(H−L); R2/S2 = ± 2×), built from 1m bars resampled to 15m.
entry: Checked every tick from window open until 2:00 left, once per window.
First: the last CLOSED 1m candle opened on one side of a line and closed on the other = 'Close above X' (long) / 'Close below X' (short).
Else: price within 0.35 of that line's unit (σ for session lines, 15m pivot range for pivot lines) of the nearest line = 'On X', long if at/above it, short if below.
Skip if another line sits between price and the strike (more than 0.2 unit away from price).
Skip if the session VWAP is on the wrong side of both price and the strike.
Price: 1.38x and up (ask ≤ 72.5c), no upper cap; ask > 2c.
exits: Paper: half at 75% of the max, rest arms at 90% with a 1-point trail, sells at 97c, else the bell. Live: the same (half 75 / trail 90) + wide lock (+60% then back to +30%) + gold cut-out ($2.50 past the strike). LOCK THE WIN / TP gates / paper mirroring off.
stake: $20 paper, live dollars per desk setting
